title: ficus pedunculosa var. mearnsii
intro: Ficus pedunculosa var. mearnsii, commonly known as the Mearns' fig, is a plant species in the fig family (Moraceae) native to the Philippines. The Mearns' fig is said to have potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The plant's therapeutic actions include its possible role in treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as its potential anti-cancer properties. Bioactive constituents of the Mearns' fig include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
